title: Adaptive schema relaxation validation harness for JSON mode edge recovery
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Goal: build a deterministic, repeatable test harness that validates behavior of JSON mode + constrained decoding when the model produces partial, malformed, or truncated streams and ensure the adaptive schema relaxation path degrades gracefully and observably.

Context: We have many tickets covering strict schema gating and constrained decoders, but field reports show production flows occasionally produce near-JSON outputs (missing trailing commas, truncated arrays, interleaved toolcall markers). Instead of hard failure, the platform should apply a controlled relaxation policy (whitelist simple repairs, permissive parsing heuristics, or trigger a lightweight re-sampling fallback) and surface both the repair and the confidence level to callers. This ticket implements an automated harness to exercise those recovery paths across models, quantizations, and streaming modes.

Scope:
- Test harness that can drive streaming responses with injected anomalies (truncation, token corruption, mid-stream tool-call markers).
- Plug-in for schema-relaxation policies: repair-first heuristics, accept-with-warning, forced-resample, and toolcall-stripping.
- Metrics capture: recovery_rate, false_accept_rate (repair that changes semantics), mean_repair_latency, tokens_reprocessed, and downstream eval regression rate.
- Integration points: constrained-decoder config, streaming assembler, decoder telemetry, and Console observability dashboards.

Non-goals: exhaustive fuzzing of all tokens. We will focus on reproducible edge cases and a curated adversarial set that previously caused incidents or near-incidents.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness can replay 1k curated streaming anomaly scenarios deterministically.
2) For each scenario the harness records chosen relaxation policy, repair diff, and a confidence tag.
3) Recovery rate target >= 90% for non-semantically-breaking repairs on curated set.
4) False accept rate <= 3% measured by downstream evaluator on seeded prompts.
5) Console charts ingest the harness metrics and a sample of repaired payloads for inspection.
6) PRs with implementation pass CI and include unit tests for 4 representative heuristics.
test_plan:
Test matrix: models=[redwood-small, redwood-base, redwood-xl, community-llama-2-13b], quantizations=[fp16,int8,q4_0], streaming_modes=[chunked,server-sent-events], network_conditions=[normal, 200ms jitter, 1% packet loss], anomalies=[truncate-last-object, drop-closing-brace, stray-toolcall-token, repeated-escape-sequences].

For each cell: 1) Seed RNG with fixed seed. 2) Emit streaming tokens with injected anomaly at t=T. 3) Run constrained decoder with schema X and relaxation policy Y. 4) Record telemetry and persist raw stream + repaired JSON. 5) Run semantic-checker to detect content drift.

Automation: tests run nightly on a durability pipeline and on every PR that touches the streaming assembler or constrained decoder code paths.
implementation_notes:
- Create harness service inside tests/structured_output/harness with pluggable anomaly injectors.
- Implement three initial relaxation policies: repair-syntax, accept-with-warning (annotate metadata), forced-resample (append re-sample request in decoder loop).
- Add a 'repair diff' serializer that produces stable, compact patch strings for audit in Console.
- Ensure telemetry emits a 'repair_decision' tag with policy, latency_ms, and debug snippet (max 256 chars).
- Backstop: if repair cost > threshold or semantic drift detected, route to strict-fail path and increment 'escalation' metric.
- Coordinate with observability team to add dashboard tiles and a sample viewer for repaired payloads.
- Add synthetic prompts modeled on real customer incident logs (anonymized).
risks:
- Over-reliance on permissive repairs could surface semantically incorrect outputs to customers.
- Repair heuristics may be model-specific; need to validate across quantizations.
- Increased latency when falling back to resample or running semantic-checker.
- Telemetry verbosity must be throttled to avoid cost and PII leaks.
edges_and_scenarios: Truncated array where final ']' is dropped mid-stream
Interleaved toolcall token sequence that looks like JSON separators
Streaming that ends with an open object then resumes a minute later (reconnection)
Stray unescaped newline inside string leading to premature parser termination
